Chapter 7066: Demise Tablet

Chapter 7066: Demise Tablet

“Enough of this, you’re not leaving this place.” Heaven’s Demise said.

“I have the opposite view, there is no point for the dead to linger here. I will send you all on your way.” Li Qiye said.

“Come, show us if you are equal to the high heaven.” Heaven’s Slayer said.

“So be it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Don’t worry, there’s a place among us for you once you die.” Heaven’s Demise added.

“You can revive celestial immortals?” On the other hand, Zhao Dachui still wanted to speak.

“There are two problems with you.” Li Qiye said.

“Go on.” Zhao Dachui became eager.

“First of all, I can truly revive celestial immortals, Dusk is an example. Secondly, and more importantly, I don’t hold you in high regard enough to bother.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“You!” Zhao Dachui’s expression soured.

“Dusk was revived?” Listeners beyond the ocean couldn’t believe it.

“Then he can revive anyone.” A primordial immortal said.

“Interested?” Li Qiye smiled at Dragongrasp and the others.

“No, fight!” Heaven’s Demise leaped out of the five elements and the reincarnation cycle.

No one could spot him again.

“Demise Tablet!” His voice came from the unknown, unleashing a tablet from above capable of crushing the high heaven’s laws.

“So this is a celestial immortal!” One spectator shouted after being suppressed entirely.

The tablet was his ultimate dao, imbued with special runes. Before they knew it, tablets existed everywhere in Heavenrealm. All soared toward Li Qiye to destroy both his body and mind.

“Whoosh!” Dragongrasp coiled around Li Qiye before the tablets could get there. It was as if Li Qiye was wrapped in countless layers of black cloth.

When Dragongrasp tightened, the physical pressure became immense.

“Slayer Inferno!” Heaven’s Slayer joined the fray, pouring his flame precisely at Li Qiye.

Although he didn’t have a paramita body, just a single ember from him could burn immortals. He had used this flame to stop fiery tribulations previously.

“Source Devourer!” Zhao Dachui seemingly sacrificed his body to curse Li Qiye.

“Buzz.” He turned into a singularity capable of reducing the nine major worlds into nothingness.

The four celestial immortals used their strongest technique. Alas, Li Qiye smiled in response and opened his mouth, swallowing all four attacks in the blink of an eye.
